protocol.method: Gradient fine-tuning of the last two transformer layers and an eight-class linear head
protocol.dataset_source: Assistant-authored synthetic examples, not real pupil observations
protocol.selection: Operational task simplified after validation error analysis; choose model by collapsed validation macro F1. Final comparison is developmental, not an independently authored benchmark.
protocol.comparison_rule: Validation macro F1 >= .80, control macro F1 >= .80, control accuracy above majority baseline
protocol.task: Three-way review triage: complaint, positive, insufficient information
